quotes.text: ¿Cuántas horas a la semana trabaja normalmente.... en este trabajo?
Cocinar, lavar los platos, poner la mesa en: a. Su hogar? Sí 1 Días Horas día
Cuidar niñas o niños menores de 5 años que no estén enfermos ni en condición de discapacidad en: a. Su hogar? Sí 1 Días Horas día

assessments.reasoning: The survey instrument captures time allocation across multiple types of activities. In Chapter I (Question 52), it records weekly hours spent on paid employment. In Chapter K (Questions 1 through 6 and 13 through 23), it asks respondents about time devoted to various unpaid care, domestic, autoconsumption, and volunteer activities, recording both the number of days and the hours per day devoted to each. This establishes that the questionnaire records time allocated to more than one kind of activity beyond paid work.
